checkup.title: Health check-up
checkup.intro: Answer what you can. You can skip any question. Skipping never counts against you.

sources.recalled: From memory or a recent reading

issues.systolic_not_above_diastolic: The top number should be higher than the bottom number.

wellness.declined: You chose to skip the mood and stress questions.
wellness.stopped: You stopped the mood and stress questions. You can still send the rest of your check-up.

results.deleteConfirm: Delete this check-up and its results? This cannot be undone.

home.heroTitle: Let's look after your everyday health
home.firstCheckup: Start with a short check-up. It takes about five minutes.

guidePanel.title: Ask Rinda
guidePanel.intro: Pick a question. Rinda answers from your own results.
guidePanel.needCheckup: Do a check-up first so Rinda can answer.
guidePanel.offline: You are offline, so Rinda answered from approved guidance on this phone.
guidePanel.unavailable: Rinda’s guide cannot answer right now. The answer here comes from our approved guide, or you can go back.

offline.savedOnPhone: Saved on this phone, not sent yet
offline.provisionalTitle: Your results, worked out on this phone
offline.provisionalBody: You are offline. These results will be checked again and saved when you are back online.

install.title: Install Rinda
install.body: Add Rinda to your home screen so it opens like an app and keeps working without internet.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.installed: Rinda is installed on this device.

consent.needConnection: Rinda needs an internet connection the first time, to save your consent choices. Please connect and try again.

working.title: Setting up this phone…
working.body: Linking this phone to your Rinda session.

done.title: This phone is ready
done.body: Taking you to sign in. Everything is cleared from this phone when the session ends.

failed.title: This code did not work
failed.body: It may have expired or already been used. Ask the facilitator for a new code.

handover.waitingBody: They will send themselves when this phone is online again. No internet here? You can hand them to the facilitator now.
handover.title: Hand over to the facilitator
handover.intro: Hold this screen up to the facilitator's laptop camera until they say it is received.
handover.hold: Keep the phone still; the codes change by themselves.
handover.locked: Your answers are locked inside the codes. The laptop cannot read them; only the Rinda server can open them.
handover.noPass: This phone needs to be online once after signing in before it can hand over. Your check-ups are safe and will send when it is online.
handover.qrAlt: QR code for the facilitator to scan
handover.refresh: For your privacy, a new code appears every 2 minutes. Any code still on screen works.
handover.still: Keep the phone still until the facilitator says it is received.
handover.waitingOther: Something is saved on this phone
